title: BanglishRev: A Large-Scale Bangla-English and Code-mixed Dataset of Product Reviews in E-Commerce
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of an e-commerce product review dataset for sentiment analysis in Bengali, English, and Banglish. While it includes a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section discussing data imbalance and anonymity, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
